$comment: The deployment-specific inventory of alternative-venue codehashes to block. FuelCore.setBlockedVenueCodehash reverts once the token launches, so anything omitted here can never be added to this deployment. Every entry was read from chain with eth_getCode and hashed; see docs/adr/0002-enforce-a-single-uniswap-v4-market.md for what this can and cannot cover.

entries.label: uniswap-v3-swap-router-02
entries.rationale: The standard path to swap on a Uniswap V3 pool. V3 pools embed token0, token1 and fee as immutables, so each pool has its own codehash and the pools themselves cannot be enumerated. The singleton router can be.

entries.label: uniswap-v3-position-manager
entries.rationale: The standard path to add liquidity to a Uniswap V3 pool. Without liquidity provision no V3 market can form, which makes this the more load-bearing of the two V3 entries.

entries.label: uniswap-v3-migrator
entries.verifiedBy: listed for chainId 84532 in the Uniswap deployments feed
entries.rationale: Moves liquidity into a V3 pool without going through the position manager, so leaving it out would leave the V3 liquidity path half-closed.

entries.label: uniswap-universal-router
entries.verifiedBy: listed for chainId 84532 in the Uniswap deployments feed
entries.rationale: Routes to V2, V3 and V4 alike. The protocol trades exclusively through its own CanonicalRouter, so blocking this closes a route without closing any route the product uses.

entries.label: uniswap-swap-proxy
entries.verifiedBy: listed for chainId 84532 in the Uniswap deployments feed
entries.rationale: Ships alongside the universal router and can mediate the same swaps, so blocking one without the other leaves the pair inconsistent.

entries.label: uniswap-v4-pool-swap-test
entries.verifiedBy: listed for chainId 84532 in the Uniswap deployments feed
entries.rationale: A public V4 router that can reach any pool in the PoolManager. CanonicalMarketRegistry.isAuthorizedFuelSettlement already rejects unauthorized PoolManager settlement, so this is defence in depth rather than the primary control.

entries.label: uniswap-v4-pool-modify-liquidity-test
entries.verifiedBy: listed for chainId 84532 in the Uniswap deployments feed
entries.rationale: The liquidity-provision counterpart to PoolSwapTest, and public on this testnet in a way it is not on mainnet.

entries.label: uniswap-liquidity-launcher
entries.verifiedBy: listed for chainId 84532 in the Uniswap deployments feed
entries.rationale: Creates new liquidity-bootstrapping markets for an arbitrary token, which is precisely the alternative-venue formation this blocklist exists to prevent.

entries.label: pancakeswap-v3-swap-router
entries.source: resolved on chain; PancakeSwap V3 is the only non-Uniswap AMM found deployed on Base Sepolia
entries.rationale: PancakeSwap V3 is a Uniswap V3 fork, so its pools carry the same per-pool immutables and are equally non-enumerable. Its router is the enumerable part.
